item.title: YouTube's $60B revenue revealed amid paid subscriber push
item.description:
📝 YouTube's $60bn revenue revealed amid paid subscriber push4 days agoShareSaveLiv McMahonTechnology reporterShareSaveGetty ImagesGoogle has revealed YouTube brought in more than $60bn (£44bn) in revenue in 2025 as the firm targets getting more subscribers. He said it has been "innovating to meet consumers where they are" with new, cheaper YouTube TV and Premium tiers. "The lion's share of YouTube's content is user-generated versus 'Hollywood'-generated," he said.
